note: The deterministic scanner (bin/lint-scan.py) was verified 2026-08-13 by planting each defect class into a scratch copy of a real vault and confirming detection — see ids 0-8, all of which exercise the scanner rather than the model. Ids 9-12 cover the judgment half and are NOT verified: they need fixture vaults with deliberately contradictory content, which do not exist yet.
status: scanner verified by planted canaries; judgment half unverified

evals.expected_output: SCANNER/link: a wikilink with no matching note is reported as an error with the containing file's path
SCANNER/domain: a note whose domain is not declared in vault-profile.yml is an error; 'concepts' is exempt as a reserved value
SCANNER/type: a type in neither the base registry nor types.add is an error
SCANNER/frontmatter: a type's profile-declared required key, when missing, is an error. type: index is exempt from domain/created — generated maps carry neither.
SCANNER/lexicon: a concept note whose '## Source (verbatim)' block no longer matches raw/key-terms.md is an error — a terms pass was missed and the wiki disagrees with the glossary
SCANNER/orphan: a note unreachable from wiki/index.md by following wikilinks is a warning
SCANNER/stale: an active project whose updated date exceeds conventions.stale_project_days is a warning, using the vault's own threshold (7 in the work example, 14 default)
SCANNER/orphan-project: when conventions.project_parent is set, a project linking to no note of that type is a warning; when null, projects standing alone is NOT a finding
SCANNER/robustness: profile values with trailing inline comments parse as their scalar type, not strings; a vault with no findings prints clean and exits 0
JUDGMENT/contradiction: two notes asserting incompatible facts are reported with both sides quoted and paths given, and are NOT silently resolved
JUDGMENT/no-fabricated-dates: a note missing `updated` is repaired using the file's last commit date, never today's date
JUDGMENT/boundaries: raw/ is never edited; lexicon drift is reported as 'run a compile' rather than regenerated here; engine paths are reported as drift, never repaired locally
JUDGMENT/ambiguity: a broken link with two plausible targets is reported rather than guessed; a broken link with exactly one obvious match is fixed and disclosed
